settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• People experiencing dullness or hyperpigmentation
  • Anyone looking to boost collagen production and skin elasticity
  • Those exposed to daily environmental stressors (like pollution or UV rays)
  • Individuals aiming to prevent or reduce fine lines and wrinkles
  • Skincare enthusiasts who want to maintain a youthful, radiant glow

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Cleanse: Start with a clean, dry face. Use toner if desired.

Apply: Gently press 2–3 drops of serum into your skin, focusing on problem areas.

Finish: AM: Follow with sunscreen ;PM: Apply moisturiser.

Use daily for best results.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Brightens and Evens Skin Tone: Enhances radiance while reducing dark spots and hyperpigmentation.
  • Boosts Collagen and Elasticity: Promotes firmer, more youthful-looking skin.
  • Reduces Fine Lines and Wrinkles: Smooths the appearance of aging signs for a revitalized look.
  • Protects Against Environmental Damage: Provides antioxidant and UV defense to shield skin from stressors.

settings.title: Ingredients
settings.content: Aqua (Filtered) Water, Organic Vegetable Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Organic Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Extract, Organic Camella Sinensis (White Tea) Leaf Extract, Ubiquinone, CoQ10, Tocopherol Acetate (Vitamin E) Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Citrus) Peel Oil, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate.

settings.heading: Here How Revital C Serum works
settings.section_content:
Your skin deals with a lot — sun, stress, pollution, and long days. This serum helps it bounce back.
Revital C uses a high-strength dose of Vitamin C to gently brighten your skin, support collagen, and fade spots over time. It’s made to soak in quickly and get to work beneath the surface — helping your skin feel smoother, look more even, and stay protected all day.
It’s a small step in your routine that makes a big difference.

settings.heading: What makes it different
settings.image_content: It’s built for people who are serious about long-term skin health, not just a glow-up. It supports your microcurrent routine, fights back against environmental stress, and helps your skin regenerate — day after day.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What does Revital C do for the skin?
settings.text1: It brightens dull skin, fades dark spots, boosts collagen, and helps reduce fine lines for a more youthful look.
settings.title2: Is it safe for all skin types?
settings.text2: Yes, it suits most skin types, but we recommend a patch test before full use, especially if you have sensitive skin.
settings.text3: Yes! Use it once a day—morning or night. If used in the morning, always follow with sunscreen.
settings.title4: How long before I see results?
settings.text4: Visible improvements like brighter tone and smoother skin may appear within 2–4 weeks of consistent use.
settings.title5: Can it help with dark spots or acne marks?
settings.text5: Yes, the high concentration of Vitamin C helps fade dark spots and post-acne pigmentation over time.
